summary: Round 2: applied the minor version bump 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0 in package.json and package-lock.json, and updated the pinned version assertion in __tests__/ZestButtonToggle.test.tsx (allowed by the engine decision). Slice 1 parts (types, compileToggleStyle, toggleStyleSheet, useToggleStyle, ZestGlobalConfig.styles, ZestButton toggle wiring, exports) were already in place. Build passes; all project test suites pass (failures only in stale .devteam scratch copies, outside the project). Docs are left for the next slice. Finished slice 2: documentation for toggle styling (README example, api.md ZestToggleStyle and ToggleOptions.style, configuration.md Toggle Styling, features.md, examples.md Recipe 9, development.md internals, breaking-changes.md 1.8.0 additive) and a documentation test for R10. The earlier attempt's code and tests (types, compile, sheet, hook, button wiring, exports, version 1.8.0) were checked and left unchanged. Build succeeds, tsc is clean, and all 24 suites / 300 tests under __tests__ pass. A repo-wide jest run also picks up stale copies under .devteam/runs/*/scratch which fail on old version asserts; those are not project tests.

tests.name: R1: a toggle outside any provider has no generated style hook and keeps aria-pressed

R2: any CSS property is applied exactly as written, including px
R2: kebab-case and camelCase are the same property and are emitted once
R2/R8: an unknown property is passed through but bad values drop only themselves
R2: injection value is dropped and cannot add rules (12 cases)
R2: a property name that tries to break out is dropped
R3: each state gets its own selector; disabled and busy come after on/off
R3: hover looks sit inside a hover-capable media query and exclude disabled

R3/R7: check-mark colour and size style the check element, not the button
R4: size, variant and base layer, variant beats size beats base, other properties merge

R5: theme looks beat theme-less looks and only the active theme applies
